title: TenancyPayoutAccountChangedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.payout_account.changed` version 1: a partner stated or changed its payout account, which is unverified again. Never the account itself. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

account_changed.description: Whether the account itself (number or IFSC) changed, which holds the next payout.
